# Ring: a flat octagonal ring on the floor round a mirror, the hover marker. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Ring --base-color 0.6863 0.1529 0.2784 --no-slot
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 8 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.56 --minor-radius 0.06 --location 0 0 0.03
scale 1 1 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Ring
shade flat
export ring.glb
